description: This PHP class defines a model for employee pictures within the OrangeHRM project's API. It implements serialization and normalization for API responses, encapsulating properties like employee number and picture metadata, and references an entity class EmpPicture.

classes.name: EmployeePictureModel
classes.description: A model representation of employee picture data for API serialization, including metadata such as filename, file type, size, width, and height, linked to an EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeePictureModel with an EmpPicture entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
